Weathered olive corrugated roofs, muted red brick or timber edge caps, warm packed gravel/earth, subdued grass, period 1940s equipment. EXACT90degree vertical NADIR ORTHOGRAPHIC roof plan, all outer roof edges perfect rectangles parallel to image axes, no visible facade, door, windows, upright shaft, front wall or side elevation anywhere. Chimneys circular or square TOP openings only, all vertical posts only top endcaps, wheels viewed edge-on thin strips, machinery only horizontal top surfaces.
